name: Pet Persistence Loop
description: A durable companion loop: a player gains pet inventory state, the state marks the save system dirty, persistence writes safely, and a profile session owns the loaded state.

connections.note: Acquiring a pet marks player state dirty for saving.
Save completion enters the safe write/retry layer.

acceptanceCriteria: A pet acquired into inventory marks the player save state dirty.
A profile session is loaded before pet state is used.
A save event enters the safe datastore write path.
A player can leave and return with the pet ownership state restored.
